steps.text: Bring a pick and a rope.
Go down into the Ancient Temple north of Thais, two floors.
steps.source: Go to the Ancient Temple, north of Thais (Mapper Coords 126.100, 125.171, 7).

steps.text: Follow the way south and go down.
steps.source: Once down the steps, follow this path to the south and go down a level.

steps.text: Go east past the orcs and over the drawbridge (if it's up, the lever is south of it through a narrow passage), then east and south past the beholders to the dead end at the water. Use your pick on the west wall and go down: 3 beholders below, so run to the box.
steps.source: Head East, through some Orcs. You will come to some water, and a drawbridge. If the bridge is down, go across it, otherwise flip the switch. Keep going east (through two Bonelords) and then south, through two more Bonelords, until you reach a dead-end against some water. The pick hole is hidden against the west wall.

steps.text: In the box in the north-east corner: a life ring and a dragon necklace.
steps.source: The quest box is in the north-east corner of this room.
